title: WebHound Corpus Manifest Record
description: One record per corpus document (raw or normalized). The index of record for provenance, authority, freshness, license, PII/retention class, and lineage. Phase 2 schema; the corpus is empty until ingestion (Phase 5).

doc_id.description: Stable unique id for this document (e.g. content-hash- or slug-based).

source_name.description: Human name of the source (e.g. 'OWASP WSTG', 'Cloudflare Docs', 'URLHaus').

source_url.description: Canonical source URL or local pointer. MUST NOT embed secrets/tokens.

doc_role.description: Optional finer-grained document role (Phase 5C) used for retrieval weighting. Distinct from source_type/authority_tier.

authority_tier.description: A=official docs/standards, B=research papers, C=official repos/release notes, D=threat feeds/provider KBs, E=community.

version.description: Source version / release / commit, if any.

last_updated.description: Last-updated timestamp AT THE SOURCE (ISO-8601), if known.

first_ingested.description: When WebHound first ingested this doc (ISO-8601).

content_hash.description: Hash of the stored content (e.g. 'sha256:...') for integrity + dedupe.

citability.description: Optional: how this may be cited (e.g. 'internal_only', 'customer_safe', 'cite_with_source').

entities.description: Optional extracted entities (providers, CWEs, malware families, tools).

related_docs.description: doc_ids of related corpus docs (graph edges).

lineage.description: For normalized items: pointer back to the raw source.

trust_label.description: Optional trust label: trusted_local | official_verified | community_untrusted | feed_untrusted | needs_review | deprecated.

normalized_path.description: Repo-relative path to the committed normalized artifact for this record. Added Phase 6D.
